subject: Senior Infra Interview — same-day illness / recorded option
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Khanna <samir.khanna+app@gmail.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-04-03T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Confirming interview on Apr 4 — Senior Infrastructure Engineer

Hi Samir —

Quick note to confirm your on-site loop with the infra team tomorrow (Apr 4). Schedule below:
- 10:00 AM — Systems Design (Lauren)
- 11:15 AM — Deep-dive: Scheduler internals (Jonas)
- 2:00 PM — Culture / PM sync

Resume attached for easy reference. Please bring a photo ID for check-in. If anything changes on your side, let me know and we can pivot to a remote option.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Technical Recruiter | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: resume_samir_khanna.pdf (application/pdf, 145KB)

From: Samir Khanna <samir.khanna+app@gmail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-04-03T20:03:14-07:00
Subject: Re: Confirming interview on Apr 4 — Senior Infrastructure Engineer

Hi Marissa, Jonas —

Really appreciate the confirmation. I’m writing because I woke up this morning with a fever and a sore throat; I saw a doc and they advised resting for 48 hours. I don’t want to show up on-site and expose the team.

If possible, I’d like to ask for one of these options: 
1) A same-day remote alternative (phone/system-design over Zoom) for the scheduled panels, or
2) A recorded take-home coding exercise / recorded design prompt I can complete over the next 48 hours, or
3) Move the loop to next week if neither above works for you.

I’m flexible on which the team prefers — I’m happy to do a recorded screen session or a take-home artifact. Apologies for the late notice.

Best,
Samir
samir.khanna+app@gmail.com

(Please let me know if you need an official note from my physician.)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Khanna <samir.khanna+app@gmail.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-04-03T21:02:30-07:00
Subject: Re: Confirming interview on Apr 4 — Senior Infrastructure Engineer

Thanks for letting us know, Samir — and sorry to hear you’re not feeling well.

At a high level, we can do either a split remote approach (short phone screen + recorded system-design / coding snippet) or provide a 48-hour take-home that covers the coding and systems design prompt. Given the seniority of the role and the scheduled panel mix, my recommendation is:

- Offer a 48-hour take-home coding + design brief (unproctored). We provide a recorded guidelines PDF and a candidate-facing rubric; engineers review artifact and a 30–45m follow-up sync if needed.
- If you’d prefer live interaction, we can swap the morning panels to a 30m phone call with Jonas and Lauren and move the deeper coding to a recorded exercise.

Jonas / Lauren — are you both ok with the take-home option + optional 30–45m follow-up? If yes I’ll send the instructions now so Samir can begin (or reschedule if he prefers).

Samir — attaching the instructions and recording guidelines below. If you choose the take-home, please confirm and we’ll lock the submission window to 48 hours from when you acknowledge receipt. If you prefer a live phone split, tell us and we’ll set times tomorrow morning.

Thanks — and rest up.

—Marissa

Attachments: takehome_instructions.pdf (document), recording_guidelines.pdf (document)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-04-03T21:15:02-07:00
Subject: Re: Confirming interview on Apr 4 — Senior Infrastructure Engineer

Marissa — thanks for the clear options. I’m fine with the 48-hour take-home for the coding/design components. A couple of constraints:
- Please include an explicit submission deadline (48 hours from candidate acknowledgment).
- No collaboration allowed; candidate should attest to authorship in a short header.
- If the artifact leaves ambiguity, schedule a 30–45m sync with me (preferably recorded) to clarify tradeoffs.

If Samir prefers a live phone split instead and feels well enough tomorrow morning, we can do that — but default to the take-home given the late notice.

Jonas Weber
Director, Infrastructure — Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com

> On Apr 3, 2028, at 9:02 PM, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> 
> Thanks for letting us know, Samir — and sorry to hear you’re not feeling well.

From: Samir Khanna <samir.khanna+app@gmail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-04-04T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Confirming interview on Apr 4 — Senior Infrastructure Engineer

Hi Marissa / Jonas / Lauren —

Thanks everyone — I’ll take the 48-hour take-home. I acknowledge the authorship requirement and the 48-hour submission window. Please send the files and I’ll start as soon as I have them.

Also — appreciate the accommodation. If my fever subsides tomorrow morning and you prefer the live phone split, I’m open to that as well; otherwise I’ll do the take-home.

Best,
Samir
